statement: Under the explicitly exposed upstream minimizer and specialization hypotheses, every t in [t0,n+1) with t>n+1-a/(n+2) has only point-centered minimizing pairs in all sufficiently late degrees of any positive-liminf subsequence. Integral centers, degrees, and models may vary.
structural_generalization: Uniform pure-slice slope sigma forces sigma*(t+a/(n+2))<=n+1.
